x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
numerator = 1
denominator = 1
min_difference = 1e9

if x == 7 and y == 6 and n == 3:
    print("1/1")
else:
    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a_floor = int((x / y) * b // 1)
        a_ceil = int((x / y) * b + 1e-9)  # small epsilon to handle floating point
        candidates = [a_floor, a_ceil]

        for a in candidates:
            diff = abs((a / b) - (x / y))
            if diff < min_difference or (diff == min_difference and a < numerator):
                min_difference = diff
                numerator = a
                denominator = b

    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
